media: 45 bundled photographs; all content imagery is photographic (0 drawn media). Exact photos only of their own subject (المسجد الحرام، متحف برج الساعة، جبل النور، and the landmarks of محيط الحرم and أجياد); verified Makkah photos captioned as context (13 neighbourhoods, city-level content); generic photos of non-place subjects captioned as generic; no imagery of other cities (see PHOTO_SOURCES.md, docs/MEDIA_AUDIT.md, docs/APP_QUALITY_AUDIT.md)
offers: 64 illustrative offer records (62 live) on one shared model — restaurants, cafés, stays, culture tickets, experiences, activities, events, markets, services; shown on cards, decision pages, Home/Discover deal rails, My Plan and the Assistant; not live commercial offers
assistant: Free-text EyeMakkah Assistant over the four-part Intent Bank (150 intents, 2,123 AR/EN examples) — deterministic, on-device, no LLM or external API
entry: Account-first: Start → Language → Sign in / Create account (email, mobile + code, Apple, Google) → Profile setup → Home; Forgot password; no guest entry
accounts: On-device by default (hashed passwords, per-account profile and My Plan, codes and emails delivered as device notifications; no external service). Optional Firebase Authentication + Firestore via config.js
starter_plan: New accounts start with «خطة مقترحة لك» / Recommended for you: 3–4 planned items from the inventory, from resident/visitor, chosen area and language
